description: Shared service plumbing for the Blazecoin website services: central Serilog logging (console + the BlazecoinLogs SQL store with audit tagging and a correlation id), the JWT signing-key guard, the token-revocation deny-list cache and JwtBearer hook, and the GeoLite2 geo-block middleware with its hot…

The managed kernel of an app with one head per platform: the host of its immutable state, the cache of the screen built from it, the contract a head's window keeps, the pacing of the frame loop, and the resolver for a head's native library.

Stellaegis primitives for modules that expose HTTP endpoints: the request context port, carrying the compartment and the actor of a request, the operations an application secures routes and data by, and the translation of errors to HTTP answers. No dependency beyond ASP.NET Core.
